acceptance: The CPU cost of a frame (sim ticks plus render work) at the high preset measured at 10 viewpoints across the city by day and night, cut wherever it can be (per-frame allocations, redundant updates, draw calls merged or instanced, culling), aiming at 144 fps
A browser test records the frame cost and draw calls at each viewpoint before and after; the real frame rate goes to PLAYTEST
features.evidence: Frame cost at High, 10 viewpoints by day and night (tests/e2e/framecost.e2e.mjs, logs/framecost.json): the sim tick 3.70 ms before to 1.78 ms after (unitPose no longer worked out for armed units with nothing engaged, nor for units whose whole beat is out of sight range of him, nor for beat checks with nothing seen), draw calls 282-496; rain drawn on the GPU (no per-frame rewrite of 3000 streaks); shaders compiled up front with compileAsync and the synchronous shader-log checks off outside dev tools and tests (they stalled on every new program); per-frame matrix and colour allocations gone (gunfeel, sky); the shadow map was already cached; render time here is software rendering's, the real frame rate is in PLAYTEST; commit perf(M9-12)
